old_clause_text: The controller and the processor shall designate a Data Protection Officer in any case where core activities consist of processing operations requiring regular and systematic monitoring of data subjects.
new_clause_text: The controller and the processor shall designate a Data Protection Officer in any case where core activities consist of processing operations requiring regular and systematic monitoring of data subjects.
notes: 100% exact text match across versions (GDPR DPO requirement).

old_clause_text: Conduct an accurate and thorough assessment of the potential risks and vulnerabilities to the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of electronic protected health information held by the covered entity.
new_clause_text: Conduct an accurate and thorough assessment of the potential risks and vulnerabilities to the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of electronic protected health information held by the covered entity.
notes: Exact text match across HIPAA framework versions.

old_clause_text: Establish and implement firewall and router configuration standards that formalize testing for all network connections and changes to firewall and router configurations.
new_clause_text: Establish and implement firewall and router configuration standards that formalize testing for all network connections and changes to firewall and router configurations.
notes: Exact text match across PCI-DSS revisions.

old_clause_text: A set of policies for information security shall be defined, approved by management, published and communicated to employees and relevant external parties.
new_clause_text:
A set of policies for information security shall be defined, approved by management, 
  published and communicated to employees and relevant external parties.
notes: Whitespace and newline padding only; zero semantic or syntactic difference.

old_clause_text: Identities and credentials are managed for authorized devices, users, and processes.
new_clause_text: Identities and credentials are managed for authorized devices, users and processes.
notes: Oxford comma removal; legal effect and scope remain identical.

old_clause_text: Members shall make and preserve books and records as required under FINRA rules, the Exchange Act and applicable Exchange Act rules.
new_clause_text: Members shall make and preserve books and records as required under FINRA rules, the Exchange Act and applicable Exchange Act rules.
notes: Renumbered sub-clause with 100% identical legal text.

old_clause_text: The entity implements logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures over protected information assets.
new_clause_text: The entity implements LOGICAL ACCESS security software, infrastructure, and architectures over protected information assets.
notes: Uppercase capitalization emphasis without legal alteration.

old_clause_text: Member States shall ensure that essential and important entities take appropriate and proportionate technical, operational and organisational measures to manage the risks posed to the security of network and information systems.
new_clause_text: Member States shall ensure that essential and important entities take appropriate and proportionate technical, operational and organisational measures to manage the risks posed to the security of network and information systems.
notes: Exact text match across NIS-2 drafts.

old_clause_text: Prior to processing personal data, the controller must identify a valid legal basis under Article 6.
new_clause_text: Before processing personal data, the controller shall determine a lawful legal basis under Article 6.
notes: Synonym substitution ('Prior to' -> 'Before', 'must identify' -> 'shall determine') with identical legal obligation.

old_clause_text: Changes to the organization, business processes, information processing facilities and systems that affect information security shall be controlled.
new_clause_text: Modifications to information processing infrastructure, organizational workflows, and IT systems impacting security must be formally managed and controlled.
notes: Paraphrased sentence structure conveying the exact same change control governance mandate.

old_clause_text: Implement procedures to verify that a person or entity seeking access to electronic protected health information is the one claimed.
new_clause_text: Establish technical verification procedures to confirm the claimed identity of any user or entity requesting access to electronic protected health information.
notes: Reworded identity verification requirement with unchanged scope and mechanism.

old_clause_text: Organizations must delete customer data within 30 days of receiving a verified deletion request.
new_clause_text: Organizations must delete customer data within 3 days of receiving a verified deletion request.
notes: Critical 10x deadline compression from 30 days to 3 days requiring operational workflow re-engineering.

old_clause_text: Infringements shall be subject to administrative fines up to 10,000,000 EUR, or in the case of an undertaking, up to 2% of total global annual turnover.
new_clause_text: Infringements shall be subject to administrative fines up to 20,000,000 EUR, or in the case of an undertaking, up to 4% of total global annual turnover.
notes: Substantive doubling of statutory penalty exposure (10M/2% -> 20M/4%).

old_clause_text: The information system should implement multi-factor authentication for remote access to privileged accounts.
new_clause_text: The information system shall enforce phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication for all remote access and local privileged accounts.
notes: Modal verb shift from advisory ('should') to strict mandatory ('shall enforce') plus expansion to local accounts.

old_clause_text: Organizations must perform external vulnerability scans at least quarterly and after any significant network change.
new_clause_text: Organizations may perform external vulnerability scans periodically as determined by annual internal risk assessments.
notes: Relaxation of strict mandatory quarterly cadence to discretionary periodic scans.

old_clause_text: This Directive applies to cloud computing service providers with greater than 250 employees in the Union.
new_clause_text: This Directive applies to all medium and large enterprises, managed service providers, and data center operators regardless of employee headcount.
notes: Major scope expansion bringing MSPs and data centers into mandatory compliance regardless of size.

old_clause_text: Customer account records and trade confirmation slips must be retained for at least 3 years.
new_clause_text: Customer account records and trade confirmation slips must be retained for at least 7 years in write-once-read-many (WORM) storage format.
notes: Retention duration expanded from 3 to 7 years plus new immutable WORM technical requirement.

old_clause_text: Each controller shall maintain a record of processing activities under its responsibility.
new_clause_text: Each data processor and sub-processor shall maintain a record of processing activities carried out on behalf of a controller.
notes: Subtle one-word entity substitution ('controller' -> 'data processor and sub-processor') shifting the legal obligor.

old_clause_text: A covered entity may disclose protected health information without individual authorization for treatment, payment, or healthcare operations.
new_clause_text: A covered entity may disclose protected health information only upon obtaining explicit, written individual authorization in all circumstances.
notes: Eliminates standard treatment/payment/operations exceptions, completely altering legal disclosure prerequisites.

old_clause_text: The entity conducts independent penetration tests on an annual schedule to identify security vulnerabilities.
new_clause_text: The entity conducts continuous third-party penetration testing on a mandatory monthly schedule to identify security vulnerabilities.
notes: High textual similarity, but modifies testing cadence from annual to monthly, requiring continuous commercial pentesting contracts.

new_clause_text: High-risk AI systems which make use of techniques involving the training of models with data shall be developed on the basis of training, validation and testing data sets that meet quality criteria.
notes: Newly introduced high-risk AI data governance mandate.

new_clause_text: Registrants must disclose any cybersecurity incident within four business days of determining that the incident is material.
notes: Newly added SEC public company 4-day materiality disclosure requirement.

new_clause_text: Financial entities shall maintain an ICT Business Continuity Policy and test ICT response mechanisms at least annually.
notes: Newly introduced financial digital operational resilience requirement.

new_clause_text: Processes for acquisition, use, management and exit from cloud services shall be established and specified in accordance with the organization's information security requirements.
notes: New dedicated cloud services control added in ISO 27001:2022 revision.

new_clause_text: This Regulation respects all fundamental rights and observes the principles recognised in the Charter of Fundamental Rights of the European Union.
notes: Informative non-binding recital added to preamble without actionable compliance impact.

old_clause_text: Personal data transfers from the European Union to US companies certified under the US Department of Commerce Safe Harbor Privacy Principles are deemed adequate.
notes: Repealed adequacy transfer mechanism; invalidates existing data transfer legal bases.

old_clause_text: Encrypt all non-console administrative access using SSL v3.0 or early TLS 1.0 protocols.
notes: Deprecated insecure protocol authorization clause removed from standard.

old_clause_text: Covered entities may continue to rely on express written consents obtained prior to the compliance transition date of April 14, 2003.
notes: Expired transition grandfathering clause removed.

old_clause_text: Personal data processed for the purpose of discharging regulatory functions are exempt from the subject information provisions in any case where the application of those provisions would prejudice the proper discharge of those functions.
notes: Repealed statutory exemption provision from superseded legislation.

old_clause_text: Note 2: Users of this standard are referred to ISO/IEC TR 20004 for general guidance on control customization.
notes: Informational footnote/reference removed without affecting operational security obligations.
